evidence.locator: Overview; From Raw Data to Model Input; data specification
evidence.statement: The official release specifies camera_traj.npz, per-frame bilateral MANO parameters and validity, calibrated video and temporally localized atomic actions. These form ordered human-state trajectories and support predictive modeling.
